values.note: $25 per site; two vehicles or one RV and tow vehicle included, $10 for a third vehicle; $10 day use. Same in the 2027 rate table. Cash, check or money order in the fee tube.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/cascade-campground ('Single Site: $25 per night', 'Additional Vehicle Fee: $10 for third vehicle') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231866/rates (2026 and 2027: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 25), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Forest Service: 'May to September', weather dependent; hosts and water may be missing early and late. 2026 dates are recreation.gov's fee seasons (first-come May 15-21, reservable May 22 - Sept 21, first-come Sept 22 - Oct 11).

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/cascade-campground ('Seasons of Use: May to September'; 'Opening and closing dates are weather dependent') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231866/rates (2026 seasons 05-15 to 10-11), read 2026-10-26

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231866 (notice 'No hookups available') + campsite catalog for 231866 (all STANDARD NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-26

values.note: 21 single-family sites: 8 first-come (2-7, 11, 12), the rest reservable; site 1 is the host's until Labor Day weekend, then first-come. Listed max vehicle lengths 22-73 ft (one pull-through, the rest back-in); nine sites list none.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/cascade-campground ('Cascade Campground offers 21 sites ... Sites 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 11 and 12 are first come, first served. All other sites are reservable. Site 1 is used by the host from mid-May to Labor Day weekend.') + campsite catalog for 231866 (Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Firewood sold on site. Outside peak season, hosts and water may not be available.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/cascade-campground ('Vault toilets and drinking water are provided. Firewood is sold on site.'; 'Outside of peak season dates, camp hosts and water may not be available.'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Reserve on recreation.gov or 877-444-6777 up to 6 months and at least four days ahead, for the 2026 season May 22 - Sept 21; first-come before and after, and 8 sites are always first-come (occupy the same night paid). Reserved weekends need Friday and Saturday nights, holiday weekends three; 'Walk-ups are exempt from the nightly minimum.' 14 consecutive nights at most. Normally full from Friday, sometimes Thursday.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/cascade-campground ('Call 877-444-6777 or visit recreation.gov at least four days in advance. A minimum stay on Friday and Saturday night is required on weekends. A three-night minimum stay is required on holiday weekends. Walk-ups are exempt from the nightly minimum.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231866 (facility_rules minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxConsecutiveStay 14, reservationCutOff 4; notices 'Reservations can be made up to 6 months in advance', 'normally full starting on Friday, sometimes as early as Thursday') + /rates (2026 Peak 05-22 to 09-21), read 2026-10-26

values.note: 50% off the camping fee for one site.

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/cascade-campground ('Interagency Senior/Access passes valid for 50% discount to the camping fee for one site'), read 2026-10-26

note: Chalk Creek Canyon about 9.5 miles up CR 162 from US-285, past Mount Princeton Hot Springs and just after Cascade Falls (Salida RD, Pike-San Isabel NF), 9,000 ft; dense Douglas fir and aspen, Chalk Creek across the road, Chalk Lake a mile east. Camping in the canyon is allowed only in its four developed campgrounds. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $25 (2026-27), 21 sites, no hookups, reservable on recreation.gov. Changed max_rig_ft 68 -> 73 (catalog pull-through site 10) and season close 09-21 -> 10-11 (09-21 was the end of the reservable season; first-come runs to Oct 11 2026; FS 'May to September'), opens 05-15. Added reservable season 05-22 to 09-21, 6-month window, 4-day cutoff, 2/3-night minimums, 14-night limit, some_sites FCFS, vault toilets, drinking water, senior/access 50%. No alert on CR 162.
flags: Entry has no phone. The Forest Service page gives Salida Ranger District 719-539-3591; recreation.gov gives (661) 702-1420 'for facility specific information' (concessionaire, not named) and says the campground has no phone service.
Agency page for the website if wanted: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/cascade-campground (website is the recreation.gov listing).
